title: IT Integrator - PSS @ING Hubs RO
full_description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help ofover 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities andoperate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Payment & Settlement Services (PSS) is a professional service provider designing, building and operating high quality and efficient payment, settlement and open banking services. We leverage our scalable payments target stack and the expertise of our people, to deliver these services.
PSS owns the generic part of the payments value chain from a Tech, Products and Operations perspective, while the business line owns the segment/country specific parts. This allows us to focus on delivering efficient payments and settlement services. The business line can focus on delivering a differentiating customer experience, levering the services provided by PSS.
The IT Integrator role is part of the TIP (True International Payments) area where Dovetail is the main payments engine. ING’s True International Payments department consists of approximately 100 employees of various nationalities, including Belgian, Brazilian, Bulgarian, Chinese, Dutch, Indian, Iranian, Irish, Russian, South African, and Turkish. We work together based in three different locations: The Netherlands, Spain, and India. Individual squads consist of five to nine engineers specializing in DevOps, Java, or FiServ’s EPP (Payment Platform) Development engineering. Together, we maintain a cluster of Java applications built around a vendor application, 50+ interfaces, and the configuration of the central application itself.
Even if you’ll start your day from the comfort of your home or drink your morning coffee in our office’s garden, your day will be quite similar when it comes to tasks. Here are your daily responsibilities:
Promote an agile atmosphere within teams by emphasizing nimble action in service of constant customer focus;
Document "as is" and "to be" processes and describe the changes required to migrate to the "to be" capability to record accurately the change required.
Facilitate delivery of features together with the squads, aligning epics and sprints, whether local in a certain country or centrally in Amsterdam or Brussels;
Coordinate features in order to have all stakeholders aligned and delivery teams streamlined;
Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and contribute to the evaluation of their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization;
Advise others on how to design new processes and systems that meet professional standards;
Facilitate the delivery of the integrated roadmap and escalate concerns or issues to management;
Contribute to stakeholder engagement through identifying stakeholders, finding out their needs/issues/concern and reacting to these by arranging meetings and events and drafting supporting materials to promote understanding and commitment;
Delivering basic project governance info with respect to “your” countries so global data and status info can be pulled up in a fast and efficient way on key moments in the project life cycle, enabling the central program to build a global view across 35 countries.
What you’ll bring to the team
Experience:5+ years in the banking industry or payments services or as IT analyst with focus on coordination and integration, but also some project management skills;Good knowledge of payments (MT - ISO15022 standard AND MX – ISO20022 standard) and current developments in the market;Good collaboration skills with stakeholders as well as development teams, identification of and communication with stakeholders;Understand complex information, architectures, and system interdependencies. Have a rich and deep understanding of root causes versus symptoms;Be able to learn while experimenting and consolidate new knowledge in order to be shared with others;Open to handle shifting demands and quick to adapt.
5+ years in the banking industry or payments services or as IT analyst with focus on coordination and integration, but also some project management skills;
Good knowledge of payments (MT - ISO15022 standard AND MX – ISO20022 standard) and current developments in the market;
Good collaboration skills with stakeholders as well as development teams, identification of and communication with stakeholders;
Understand complex information, architectures, and system interdependencies. Have a rich and deep understanding of root causes versus symptoms;
Be able to learn while experimenting and consolidate new knowledge in order to be shared with others;
Open to handle shifting demands and quick to adapt.
Nice to have:10+ years’ experience in feature engineering, integration, project management, or customer journeys for the banking industry or payments services;High level technical expertise;Experience with market leading banking software.
